data.name: Inshad
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic verb ‘insha’ which means ‘to sing or recite’ with the addition of the suffix ‘d’ which means ‘to Allah’. This name is often given to babies born into Muslim families who are expected to grow up to be devout and pious individuals who use their talents to praise and worship Allah through singing and recitation.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the constant remembrance and glorification of Allah through one's actions and talents.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Inshad are often creative, artistic, and spiritually inclined individuals who have a deep connection to Allah and a strong desire to use their talents to serve Him.
